entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise in the congregation of saints.

entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments: Let Israel rejoice in his Makers; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their Kings.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: Let them praise His name in the dance; let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the meek with salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Let the saints be joyful in glory; let them sing aloud on their beds.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: [Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: to carry out vengeance on the nations [and] punishments on the peoples,

entries.title: Psalms 149:8
segments: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with iron-bands,

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: to carry out on them the judgment written; this [is an] honor for all His saints. Praise the LORD!
